topic: Theory: Loki fights Imu to protect the giants, not to avenge Harald
title: Loki Isn't Fighting Imu For Revenge (One Piece 1193)
description: Loki and Luffy just hurt Imu together in chapter 1193. Here is my read on why Loki's fight is about the giants, not revenge. Do you agree?
comment: Is Loki fighting Imu to avenge Harald, or to save the giants? Pick one.

lines.text: Loki isn't fighting Imu for revenge. I think he's fighting for something bigger.

shot.fallback: giant prince with horns and a dark aura

lines.text: Chapter 1193. Luffy and Loki hit Imu together, and Imu goes flying through the Adam Tree.

shot.fallback: two fighters striking a shadowy ruler

lines.text: Loki isn't a hero, he's a prince the giants once feared.
So why would he risk everything to hurt a man like Imu?
Most fans say revenge, because Imu's side ruined his family.

shot.fallback: old giant king on a throne

lines.text: But watch what Imu does next.
He uses Domi Reversi on Dorry and Brogy and turns two giant legends against their own people.

shot.fallback: two giant warriors with dark eyes

lines.text: Revenge doesn't explain that. Protecting Elbaf does.

shot.fallback: giant warriors standing in a village

lines.text: And Loki is already starting his hybrid form.

shot.fallback: giant prince transforming into a beast

lines.text: Here's my read: Loki isn't avenging a king. He's guarding the last giants Imu hasn't touched.
Because Loki isn't fighting Imu for revenge...

shot.fallback: giant prince facing a shadowy ruler

self_check.hook: line 1 names the character and makes a claim

published.comment: Is Loki fighting Imu to avenge Harald, or to save the giants? Pick one.
